name: ShadowGate
english_description: A Nightmare Mudlib-lineage English-language AD&D/d20-style fantasy MUD, grown into a large, decades-developed game with feats, invocations, spell disciplines, ~50 playable races, and 14 classes, each with its own trainer NPC and a 15-stage guided character-creation wizard (class, gender, race, subrace, template, age, stat rolling, appearance, language, alignment, deity, class special). The repo's own README states this is or was a real, still-hosted MUD at shadowgate.org -- unrelated to the classic 1989 NES adventure game of the same name.
